connector.name: n8n MCP Community
connector.registryDescription: A security-focused MCP server for self-hosted n8n Community Edition.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package n8n-mcp-community. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the drzamarian account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: N8N_API_URL
env.description: Absolute HTTP(S) base URL for the intended self-hosted n8n instance; plaintext HTTP is limited to loopback unless explicitly allowed.

env.name: N8N_API_KEY
env.description: Dedicated least-privilege n8n Public API key.

env.name: N8N_MCP_MODE
env.description: Operation mode: read-only, write, or unsafe.

env.name: N8N_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
env.description: Keep 0 unless plaintext HTTP to a non-loopback host is explicitly accepted.
